# Retrieval Hints:
# 1. ALWAYS check `/AGENTS.md` before making engineering decisions
# 2. All fiscal/money logic MUST use domain value objects, not raw numbers
# 3. SUNAT compliance is a safety requirement — see domain/sunat/
# 4. The repo is a monorepo with 5 apps + 13 packages, managed by Turborepo + Bun
